meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Mainland China (PRC) - WFOE incorporation jurisdiction; Taiwan (China) - investor source jurisdiction for cross-strait notarization and verification
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Cross-Strait Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA) between the Straits Exchange Foundation and the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (2010)
Cross-Strait Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement concluded under ECFA (ARATS-SEF, 2012)
PRC Foreign Investment Law (2019) and the Regulations for Implementing the Foreign Investment Law
Regulation on the Registration Administration of Market Entities (PRC State Council Order No. 746, 2021)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law (2024 revision, effective 1 January 2025); PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3 'Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information of Market Entities' (effective 1 November 2024); PRC Counter-Terrorism Law; SAMR Regulations on the Registration Administration of Market Entities; Taiwan Money Laundering Control Act and Taiwan Company Act for the investor leg; cross-strait verification governed by the SEF/ARATS notarization and verification agreements.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Business Registration Certificate of the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan notary public notarization -> Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) verification -> Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS) verification in the PRC -> certified simplified-Chinese translation. Hague Apostille and consular legalization are not applicable and must never be appended; the cross-strait SEF/ARATS verification is the exclusive parallel authentication path.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Current Business Registration Record of the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan notary public notarization -> Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) verification -> Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS) verification in the PRC -> certified simplified-Chinese translation. This replaces any potential Hague Apostille or consular legalization route.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney authorizing incorporation of the WFOE and execution of the shareholders agreement
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Corporate board resolution notarized before a Taiwan notary public with board members' signatures and company seal -> SEF verification -> ARATS verification -> certified translation. No apostille or consular legalization is to be chained to this sequence.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Company Constitution of the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) certified copy; board of directors of the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: MOEA-certified copy notarized at a Taiwan notary public -> SEF verification -> ARATS verification -> certified simplified-Chinese translation. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive non-applicable paths for Taiwan-issued instruments.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter issued for the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original bank reference letter with notarized specimen signature of the bank officer -> SEF verification -> ARATS verification -> certified translation if not issued in English. The bank letter cannot be legalized by consulate or apostille because Taiwan is not a Hague Apostille state and cross-strait verification is the sole operative path.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport or Taiwan identification card and proof of residential address for each UBO, director, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan household registration authority (Ministry of the Interior) or Taiwan notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Identity documents notarized in Taiwan -> SEF verification -> ARATS verification -> certified translation. No Hague Apostille or consular legalization may be added sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration and beneficial-ownership structure chart of the Taiwan investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Directors of the Taiwan investing company, notarized before a Taiwan notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Signed UBO declaration and ownership chart notarized in Taiwan -> SEF verification -> ARATS verification -> filing with SAMR/PBOC through the Chinese partner or legal counsel. This is a government-only-access filing under the 2024 PBOC/SAMR UBO regime.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, senior managers, and authorized signatories of the Taiwan investor and the proposed WFOE must be screened before incorporation and then continuously. Screening sources must include OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the 50% ownership aggregation rule, non-SDN sanctions lists, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, PRC sanctions and unreliable entity lists, Taiwan designated persons list, FATF public statements and high-risk jurisdiction lists, and commercial adverse-media databases. Foreign PEPs, domestic PEPs, and international-organization PEPs must be identified; family members and close associates of PEPs require enhanced due diligence and senior-management approval.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR National Enterprise Name Self-Service Reservation and Registration Portal via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (NECIPS) and the State Council Integrated Online Government Services Platform for Market Entities
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered name of the WFOE must be in simplified Chinese characters under the statutory four-tier structure: administrative division + distinctive trade name (字号) + industry or business characteristic + 'limited liability company' tail. Traditional Chinese characters from Taiwan must be converted to simplified Chinese. A pinyin or English trade-name transliteration may be used only as an additional language version; the simplified Chinese name is the operative legal name, and any English name must be consistent with the Chinese name and registered as a secondary name where permitted.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Military, Army, Navy, Air Force, National Defense
Bank, Securities, Insurance, Fund, Trust, Finance, Futures
Petroleum, Petrochemical, Gold, Space, Aviation, Nuclear
Tax, Customs, Court, Arbitration, Ministry names and other state-organ equivalents
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On rejection, the applicant should read the rejection reason, amend the intended name, and file a new name reservation through the same portal. If the applicant disputes the rejection, it must file an administrative reconsideration application with the SAMR bureau that issued the rejection within 60 days, or directly file an administrative lawsuit with the competent people's court. A lawyer's opinion identifying the non-infringing distinctive token and any prior same or similar registrations should accompany the appeal. No automatic extension exists for the 30-day reservation; if approval risk remains, reserve a second permitted name variant simultaneously.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For a WFOE in the email-infrastructure SaaS industry, a pure virtual office or postal mailbox will not satisfy SAMR's registered business-address requirement and will be rejected for tax invoice issuance and bank account opening. A physical commercial lease with a standalone entrance is required. Certain free-trade-zone clusters allow address clustering, but such arrangements still require actual staffing where banks conduct KYB site visits. The use of a virtual office materially increases the risk of deregistration, tax exception status, and bank account termination.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: 15-25% in the first year for a genuine full-service lease; 70-90% if a virtual or cluster address is used; 95% or higher if tax abnormality is triggered. Checklist: (1) lease contract term, landlord title certificate and bank-rent payment trail; (2) signage and nameplate at the physical address; (3) utility and telecom bills matching the WFOE name; (4) employees present during normal business hours; (5) original books and corporate documents available for SAMR 'double-random one-public' inspection; (6) fire-safety compliance certificate; (7) bank KYB on-site verification. Non-compliance may result in removal of registration or abnormal-operations listing.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act (公司法), Articles 1-7, 128-156, 161, 387-388; Foreign Investment Act (外國人投資條例) Articles 4-9 and 13; Enforcement Rules of the Company Act (公司法施行細則) Articles 2-6
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commerce (經濟部商業司)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Registration Application Form for a Company Ltd. by Shares (股份有限公司設立登記申請書)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital is prescribed by the Taiwan Company Act; however, for a wholly foreign-owned enterprise, the full registered capital must be remitted from overseas into a designated foreign-investor escrow account and verified by a certified public accountant before registration is approved.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: that the incorporators and the inaugural Board of Directors of [CN WFOE Ltd., Taiwan Branch] do hereby (1) approve and adopt the Articles of Incorporation and the corporate seal; (2) subscribe to 100% of the authorized registered capital, to be paid by the sole foreign shareholder into a designated capital escrow account; (3) adopt the registered office at [address], Taiwan, and authorize the resident manager to execute the lease and register such office with the Ministry of Economic Affairs; (4) appoint the first Directors and the authorized representative(s) for signing filings; and (5) open a corporate bank account for capital infusion and operational use. All filings shall be effected immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-reservation of Company Name and Business Scope
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA One-Stop Service Portal (商工行政服務入口網), Department of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online application to reserve the proposed company name and business scope in Chinese. The system will screen the name against registered companies and protected designations. Upon approval, download the name reservation certificate, which is valid for six months; business scope must include computer programming and email hosting infrastructure services.
required_dossiers: Proposed business scope (ISIC 6201 / email SaaS hosting)
Passport or corporate ID of the foreign shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name conflicts with an existing entity or is otherwise objectionable, the applicant may file a revised name application through the same portal within 7 days at no additional fee; a second identical rejection requires a new reservation and payment of the applicable fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Approval and Capital Escrow Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (經濟部投資審議司)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an application for foreign investment approval under the Foreign Investment Act. After approval, remit the registered capital into a Taiwan commercial bank escrow account opened in the name of the proposed company and obtain a capital verification report from a licensed CPA confirming receipt. The remittance purpose must be stated as 'company establishment capital'.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation and board resolution of the foreign investor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Investment Commission issues a correction notice, the applicant has 30 days to cure the deficiency; failing to cure leads to a dismissal. A new application may be filed after correction or supplementation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation and Initial Governance Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan District Court Notary Office or licensed private notary, concurrently with the company's appointed attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation in Chinese, including shareholder rights, capital structure, registered office address, officer designation, and dispute resolution provisions. The sole shareholder must execute the subscription resolution and the first board resolution. Notarize the documents to verify the identity and legal capacity of all signatories.
required_dossiers: First board resolution and shareholder subscription resolution
Notarized power of attorney from the foreign investor
Passport / alien residence certificate of directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies inconsistent or missing clauses, the company may resubmit corrected pages; major legal conflicts require a revised board resolution and re-notarization. There is no appeal, only re-filing of corrected documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Incorporation Registration with the Ministry of Economic Affairs
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (公司登記主管機關)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation application online or in person at the MOEA commercial registration office. Submit the full registration package: notarized articles, foreign investment approval, capital verification report, registered office consent and lease, director consent forms, and corporate seal card. Pay the registration fee and receive the Company Registration Certificate (公司登記證明書).
required_dossiers: Registered office lease / consent of the owner
Consent letters of directors and supervisor
Corporate seal and bank seal specimen card
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: MOEA may issue a correction request listing omissions; the applicant then has 15 days to amend or supplement. If the company fails to respond, the application is rejected; the company can file a fresh application after curing the defects.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Business Operation Registration, and Opening of Corporate Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau (Ministry of Finance, Taiwan) and the Department of Commerce (for business operation registration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After incorporation, complete the tax registration with the local National Taxation Bureau within 15 days to obtain a Taxpayer Uniform Number. Complete the Business Operation Registration to obtain the Operation Registration Certificate if the principal activity includes commercial provision of services. Open a corporate bank account and mandate dual signatories for the account.
required_dossiers: Corporate bank account activation form and resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is delayed or erroneous, the company may file an amended registration; late filing penalties are remitted upon showing reasonable cause. Bank account opening problems are resolved by submitting supplementary legalization / apostille documents of the foreign parent entity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commerce; Industry Licensing Unit (產業許可單位) under the Industrial Development Bureau
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Operation Registration Certificate (營業登記證明) and Company Registration Certificate (公司登記證明書)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Administration, Executive Yuan (行政院環境保護署)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – the ISIC 6201 data and email infrastructure SaaS activity is not listed as a designated EIA project under the Environmental Impact Assessment Act; office-only operations require no EIA report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for office-based operations with no industrial wastewater, VOC emission source, or hazardous waste generation. If self-hosted servers or battery rooms are installed, comply with the Waste Disposal Act for e-waste and the Air Pollution Control Act for backup generator emissions; all cooling system refrigerants must meet the Montreal Protocol thresholds.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate under the Fire Services Act for the registered office floor; structural load inspection approval from the municipal public works department; and an Occupational Safety and Health Act compliance inspection covering workplace lighting, ergonomics, emergency exits, and employee health declarations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China, official portal: https://www.chinatax.gov.cn/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities, including WFOEs, must first obtain a business license from the market regulator and then register for tax ID with the local STA. Required documents include incorporation certificate, foreign investor details, capital proof, and business scope. Approval leads to issuance of tax registration certificate and assignment of TIN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available. Classification based on legal structure. Hybrid mismatch rules apply under domestic law aligned with BEPS Action 2.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing via NTIN platform. Taxpayers must report invoice data in real-time; API connectivity required for large taxpayers. Digital stamps and clearance enforced.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of goods qualifies for 0% VAT. For offshore services such as SaaS provided to non-residents without China nexus, 0% rate applies upon proper substantiation. Criteria include export contract, proof of delivery outside China, and no local consumption.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims result in penalties of up to five times the evaded tax, interest charges, and potential criminal liability for tax evasion. Retrospective adjustments and clawbacks apply.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) and State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Chinese RMB is convertible for current account transactions, including trade in goods and services, dividends, and interest, subject to genuine transaction verification by banks. Capital account convertibility remains restricted; foreign direct investment capital injections require SAFE registration and can be converted into RMB for approved operating purposes. Profit remittance by a WFOE is permissible through the current account process: audited financial statements, tax filing/clearance certificates, board resolution on profit distribution, and a SAFE-registered basic settlement account. Dividends are subject to withholding income tax at 10% unless reduced under an applicable tax treaty, for which a certificate of tax residence is required. No capital account convertibility exists for speculative investment or unrestricted cross-border cash pooling.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the current Chinese foreign exchange regime, there is no mandatory surrender or statutory conversion ratio for export proceeds. Export receipts must be repatriated into China and directed to a designated foreign exchange account or settled into RMB at a licensed bank within the timeframe agreed by the bank and consistent with SAFE monitoring. Enterprises exercise a voluntary foreign exchange settlement (意愿结汇) policy; SAFE monitors the authenticity of receipts and the consistency of trade documentation. Failure to file declarations in the SAFE monitoring system (AsOne/数字外管) can trigger administrative sanctions and interruption of clearing facilities.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (FDI capital account) / Operational Account (RMB basic settlement account)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited (ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (RMB and foreign currency designated account)
Operational Account / Foreign Exchange Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low and legally constrained. Offshore digital EMIs (Electronic Money Institutions) are not authorised to provide in-country payment Accounts or clearing services in Mainland China. RMB settlement for a locally incorporated WFOE must be conducted through PBOC-licensed domestic banking institutions. Offshore EMI platforms may be used only as auxiliary cross-border payment or billing intermediaries, but they cannot replace domestic bank settlement rails. A contractual arrangement with an unlicensed EMI would violate the Administrative Measures for the Payment Services of Non-Financial Institutions and carry significant AML/regulatory risk.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally required for the legal representative and the authorised signatory during the onboarding interview. A remote or video-based account opening is not legally recognised as a full substitute for the first face-to-face compliance interview under PBOC's Customer Identification Management Measures. In exceptional cases, a notarised Chinese-language power of attorney can permit a designated officer of the WFOE to appear in person on behalf of the non-resident beneficial owners; however, at least one individual with executive authority must be physically present at a licensed bank branch in China. Foreign shareholders are also nevertheless required to submit corporate registry documents apostilled/legalised, board resolutions, and passport copies verified during the interview process.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholders and opaque beneficial ownership structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Corporate register extracts showing full chain of ownership, certificate of incorporation, apostilled/legalised board resolution, beneficial owner declaration form, passport copies of all directors and shareholders, and a written organisation chart identifying ultimate natural persons.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border subscription digital service platform with recurring low-mid ticket revenue and no local staff
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial agreement with local mailbox provider/processor, hosting invoices from an onshore datacenter, target market analysis, expected monthly settlement volume, and a clear AML risk self-assessment demonstrating low-money-laundering-typology profile for B2B email infrastructure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of historical audited financials for a newly incorporated WFOE
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified capital verification report (验资报告), initial bank statement showing paid-in capital, audited opening balance sheet where applicable, and a 12-month projected cash-flow statement tied to revenue contracts with identifiable counterparties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Potential red flags in trade purpose and payment declaration codes
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed client agreements, service descriptions under ISIC 6201/NAICS 518210, SAFE declaration drafts, invoice values reconciled to the contract, and documented explanation of the absence of physical goods to distinguish the transaction from prohibited trade falsification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Concerns over foreign exchange receipt and dividend remittance circularity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tax-filing certificates for all income periods, audited annual financial statements, China Enterprise Income Tax liquidation/clearance certificate, and a documented board resolution for profit distribution prepared in accordance with the Company Law and SAFE rules.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound foreign direct investment capital injection must be routed through a designated FDI capital account in the name of the WFOE held at a licensed domestic bank. The foreign shareholder initiates an SWIFT MT103 wire to the WFOE's capital account using the SAFE-registered Foreign Investment Series Identifier, with the transaction purpose code for 'Investment in foreign-invested enterprises capital contribution' (e.g. trade and project code 621013). Upon receipt, the bank verifies the authenticity of the payment and records the transaction in the SAFE reporting system. The capital may be converted into RMB within the framework of the 'agreement-based voluntary FX settlement' principle and allocated to operating expenditure only after the bank has completed the receipt confirmation and the enterprise has submitted the foreign exchange settlement declaration. Non-resident shareholder loans above the statutory debt-to-equity ratio require additional SAFE registration through the cross-border financing macro-prudential module.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade-related disbursements for services, software licensing, and infrastructure purchases are cleared through SWIFT MT103 (single remittance) or, where contracts require documentary protection, through a Commercial Letter of Credit (for physical items or structured services). The WFOE presents underlying contracts, invoices, SAFE payment declaration forms, and proof of service completion to the settlement bank. The bank performs a genuine transaction review and submits the transaction to SAFE's cross-border payment data platform. For recurring subscription licensing payments to offshore software vendors, SWIFT MT103 with service code '9F' (royalties and license fees) or '9G' (computer software services) is recommended. For equipment or hardware procurement related to email infrastructure, commercial LC with freedom from the sanctions list and full compliance with PBOC regulations is the standard clearing rail.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX options (plain vanilla call/put options on commercial underlying exposure)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report to State Administration for Market Regulation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to RMB 50,000; entity struck off after three consecutive years of non-filing
Late filing penalty 0.05% per day of tax due; possible criminal liability for evasion
Late payment surcharge 0.05% per day; fines up to 50% of unpaid tax
Fine up to RMB 100,000; possible suspension or revocation of foreign investment license

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if total assets exceed RMB 20 million, operating revenue exceed RMB 100 million, or profit exceed RMB 5 million in prior year
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: China Accounting Standards (CAS) converged with IFRS

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual UBO and shareholding confirmation required upon any change; update within 30 days of transfer or control alteration

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 25% standard rate for WFOE; reduced to 15% if qualified as high-tech enterprise

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Enterprise Income Tax Return (企业所得税纳税申报表 A类), electronic filing via State Taxation Administration (STA) national e-filing system
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 5 months after fiscal year-end (e.g. 31 May for calendar year)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate income from all sources including related party transactions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: WFOE must report worldwide income; non-resident aspects apply to related party dealings
Attach transfer pricing study if transactions exceed thresholds; ensure documentation for non-arm's length

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 1,000 RMB/day (max 10,000 RMB); underpayment: 50% of tax due plus interest; evasion: criminal prosecution

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 5% under ECFA for dividends remitted to Taiwan parent
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit application to STA with supporting TRC from Taiwan tax authority and ECFA certificate; obtain reduced WHT certificate
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 10% statutory / 6% ECFA; Interest: 7% statutory / 6% ECFA if treaty applicable

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: RMB 100 million annual revenue for Local File; RMB 2 billion for Master File
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China's Economic Substance Regulations require operational substance for tax residency benefits; applicable to holding entities but operational SaaS requires local staff, premises, and activities
